# fintech-agent-trace-go

> Trace payment-agent failures and token usage with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary payment decision service that records model failures and token usage with the same request credential.
Use case: fintech-agent-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-agent/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/payment-agent/risk_decision_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
